Incident Bot: Pager triggered - embeddings-east 5xx spike (high) - affected requests to /v1/embeddings. Pager id 1729456789
Sam (oncall): taking this, following runbook <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-5xx>
Incident Bot: runbook linked in thread.
Sam (oncall): Draft statuspage copy (initial, DO NOT publish until ops/legal ack):
```
Service: Embeddings (embeddings-east)
Impact: Increased error rate for embeddings API calls (approx 40% failures for a subset of customers). Some requests retry successfully.
Scope: Affected requests routed to embeddings-east only.
Customer impact: transient failures; best-effort retries may succeed.
Security: No evidence of data access or exfiltration so far.
Timeline: Investigating, mitigation in progress. Next update in 10 minutes.
```
Jess (ops-comm): Suggest adding a short workaround line: "Clients should retry with exponential backoff and jitter." Also trim to 2 bullets for the status page preview.
Maria (legal): Legal check: confirm there is no customer PII exposure before we say "no evidence of data exfiltration." If confirmed, we can include exact phrase.
Sam (oncall): Confirmed from logs: 503s returned from model-service after last deploy. No anomalous outbound traffic. I can say "no customer data was accessed or exfiltrated."
OpsLead: Mitigation update: rolled back the recent embeddings rollout in embeddings-east and restarting pods. Error rate trending down from ~60% -> ~15%. ETA for stable buckets ~8 minutes. Hold publish until we see steady decline under 20%.
Jess (ops-comm): Holding publish. Also request FR/DE localized snippets post-publish. @Priya (l10n) can you standby?
Priya (l10n): I can prepare localized lines after initial publish; can also pre-approve a 1-sentence snippet if you need immediate localization.
Incident Bot: Publish checklist: (1) OpsLead ack, (2) Legal ack, (3) short 2-3 bullet copy + retry guidance, (4) schedule periodic updates.
OpsLead: :thumbsup: Ok to publish initial now — errors at ~12% and falling.
Maria (legal): :white_check_mark: Legal cleared to publish the initial notice with the phrase "no customer data was accessed or exfiltrated."
Sam (oncall): Publishing initial status now. Statuspage item id=3254 posted at 1729456825.
Jess (ops-comm): Also preparing customer advisory email draft to go to affected account owners: 
```
Subject: Temporary degradation of embeddings in US-East
Body: We're investigating increased errors for embeddings requests routed to US-East. We have rolled back a recent deployment and recommend retrying requests with exponential backoff. We're monitoring and will provide updates every 10 minutes. No customer data was accessed. Link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3254
```
Sam (oncall): I'll post periodic updates here every ~10 minutes and close when steady below 1%.
(10m later)
Sam (oncall): Periodic update: Error rate down to ~0.8% for the last 5m window. Still monitoring.
Incident Bot: Automation note: waiting for 15m of <1% error rate to auto-mark resolved; otherwise ops to publish resolved notice manually.
(15m later)
Incident Bot: Resolved — embeddings-east error rate returned to baseline (~0.2%) as of 1729457400. Resolved notice published. Root cause: faulty rollout; immediate rollback mitigated impact.
